questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: To be able to select more interesting and relevant courses than at my home university could offer me

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Level was a bit higher compared to at home

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was easy. I recieved a lot of information about what I needed to do before and upon arrival e.g. how to registrer at the municipally and for classes

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Not much, only during the introduction days.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Hard, the host university could not guarantee international students accommodation. I found housing 2 weeks before going.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: There is not a lot of housing opportunities, and especially now since they are rebuilding causing less opportunities

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Very dirty, to few homes

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You had to enroll for classes through their website. Courses were found in a catalogue where you could see the workload, expectations and lerning outcomes. It help me to know if i had the qualifications to the course.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I think they sent an email and also on the homepage of the university they had a direct link with information for international students where you could find answers to different questions and also where to find the course catalogue.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was 100 % succesfull

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Think about the workload. If you also want to explore cities it might be a bit too much with difficult courses that takes a lot of your time especially since a period is 6 weeks or 3 weeks.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Workload was high, short periods, stressfull

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: High level, need 55% to pass compared to 50% at home university.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A lot of selfstudy, a lot of group work and presentations which also contributed to the final grade. Grading for lab performance and lab reports

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Food Microbiology
Nutrition Research Methodologies 
Nutrition and Cardiometabolic diseases
Nutritional Physiology
Food Digestion: Fermentation in the Gut

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Depends on their education, but i really liked Food Digestion: Fermentation in the Gut and Nutrition Research Methodologies

questions.answer: Extra rent for half a month, Sim card as my danish ran out

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Food was cheeper, alcohol not

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Many sport associations you can be part of and student associations, ESN for international students

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Join a sport association and ESN

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Market on saturdays or explore other cities in the Netherlands

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy, pretty similar to Denmark

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join the introduction days, AID. You will meet many new people and have so much fun

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Non

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Not sure

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Join AID
Remember to have fun  and explore
Also focus on your studies

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Level is high but they have so many nice facilities such as nice lecture rooms, they video record lectures so you can rewatch which is nice

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting my friends

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: That my grandmother passed away 1,5 month into my exchange semester and I had to go back home for a while. This meant that I missed out on a lot both school wise but also socially.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
